about: The manuals (modern-iaf/docs/manuals.md): each PDF's file name under pdf/, and for a jet its checklist card (modern-iaf/data/checklists/<checklist>.json), its cockpit's control table (shared/extra/models/cockpit3d/<cockpit>.json "controls" under <cockpit>_controls.json) and that cockpit's pictures (pictures/<cockpit>/); displays: {folder: [names]}, the display pictures (d_<name>.jpg) the manual takes from pictures/<folder>/ instead (the Barak's HUD on its own frame). An edition in another language names its manual (of) and its language (lang): its text is text/<lang>/<of>/. tools/manuals.py builds them all.
